info.name: Enterprise E-commerce — Inventory Module
info.description:
Module 14.8–14.9 Inventory APIs + Reports.

Base: /api/v1/inventory
Auth: Bearer JWT (ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN)

Operational:
- GET /inventory
- GET /inventory/:id
- PATCH /inventory/:id/adjust
- POST /inventory/:id/reserve
- POST /inventory/:id/release
- GET /inventory/:id/movements
- GET /inventory/alerts

Reports (read-only):
- GET /inventory/reports/summary
- GET /inventory/reports/low-stock
- GET /inventory/reports/movements
- GET /inventory/reports/reservations

request.description:
KPI summary (read-only aggregation).

Sample response:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Inventory summary report fetched successfully.",
  "data": {
    "totalInventoryRecords": 42,
    "totalProducts": 30,
    "totalAvailableStock": 1200,
    "totalReservedStock": 80,
    "totalStock": 1280,
    "activeLowStockAlerts": 5
  }
}

Movement analytics totals (read-only).

Sample response:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Movement analytics report fetched successfully.",
  "data": {
    "totalMovements": 100,
    "totalIn": 20,
    "totalOut": 15,
    "totalReserve": 30,
    "totalRelease": 10,
    "totalAdjustment": 25
  }
}

Signed quantity delta. Positive increases availableStock; negative decreases.
Triggers low-stock check.

Sample response:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Inventory adjusted successfully.",
  "data": {
    "inventory": { "availableStock": 110 },
    "movement": { "movementType": "ADJUSTMENT", "quantity": 10 },
    "previousAvailableStock": 100,
    "newAvailableStock": 110,
    "alert": null
  }
}

Active low stock alerts only.

Sample response:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Low stock alerts fetched successfully.",
  "data": [{ "status": "ACTIVE", "currentStock": 5, "reorderLevel": 10, "message": "Low stock: ..." }]
}
